mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) reduce discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing valuation multiples and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 150000) indicates labor market overheating, triggering Fed policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods meeting UNRATE<4.0 AND PAYEMS>150000, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1400) combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 330) defines late-cycle expansion, where Fed tightening expectations cause S&P 500 underperformance over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods meeting HOUST>1400 AND CPIAUCSL>330, or regime-specific return difference p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 102.0 signals robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 750000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI reading above 335 signals accelerating inflation, triggering immediate Fed tightening expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 335, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production strength (INDPRO) indicates economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 24-month window.
